title: 2020 multi-resolution label disagreement and scale audit
supersedes: datasets/manifests/2020_label_scale_audit_v1/ (frozen; v1 tables retained for traceability, not deleted)

r1_changes.A_region_attribution: source-independent Natural Earth admin-1 attribution replaces product-derived region keys in all regional tables; UNKNOWN pixels retained as region 0
r1_changes.B_domain_sensitivity: KEEP_ONLY 3,011-cell universe is primary; KEEP_PLUS_PROVISIONAL 3,021 cells reported as sensitivity (tables 3, 9, 14)
r1_changes.C_h2_language: H2 reported as NOT_SUPPORTED with observed-direction statement; H2/H3 estimand distinction recorded

git_commit: c2da9be (R1 closure commit; pipeline executed on the R1 working tree derived from base commit ce34e6374e30b0dece9660f50e69b47741729be6)
input_manifest: work/issue18/transform_manifest.json (gitignored bytes; input checksums recorded there)
terminology_policy: agreement/disagreement/external-reference agreement only; no accuracy claims (GOLD=0)
statistics_policy: W10-cell spatial block bootstrap; effect sizes reported; pixel-level N never used as independent sample count; primary inference restricted to KEEP_ONLY 3,011 cells

independent_region_attribution.source: Natural Earth 10m admin-1 states/provinces (ne_10m_admin_1_states_provinces, v5.1.1); independent of CMSA, CM-SSM and GEODATA
independent_region_attribution.rule: centroid inside province -> province; else nearest province if distance <= reach_m and the second-nearest province is farther by more than ambiguity_m; else UNKNOWN (never forced)
independent_region_attribution.note: independent labels key all regional tables in the v2 report; product-derived region tables remain available as s{30,10}_region.csv for the before/after attribution comparison
